hypothesis: The fixed CWAM Cosmos3 B5 VOM R8 iteration-20000 EMA policy, with online recurrent visual-object memory active, can complete the matched formal RoboCasa365 evaluation on one eight-GPU DLC worker.
acceptance_criterion: Exact checkpoint inventory, two four-rank policy servers, and both one-episode CUDA/EGL gates must pass; full success requires exactly 340 terminal rows and a COMPLETE record.

change.comparison: Fixed B5 VOM R8 EMA under the same online evaluator, task protocol, seed, sampler, and eight-GPU topology as the B4 R7 control.
change.online_memory: Each policy server uses only prior visual observations, appends the current observation after inference, and clears visual history on episode reset; no future or privileged rollout state is used.

config.protocol: RoboCasa365 atomic 17 tasks x 20 episodes; 8 logical shards; seed 42; max_steps 400; open_loop_horizon 12; UniPC 30 steps; guidance 1.0; action chunk 16
config.server: Two parallel four-rank FSDP policy servers on GPUs 0-3 and 4-7; each group evaluates four serial logical shards.
config.causality: Online evaluator observations, proprioception, task instruction, and causal visual history only; no future or privileged rollout state.

checkpoint.dsw_four_rank_semantic_load: 1086/1086 exact tensor readback passed during overlay publication

environment.worker_scratch: /tmp with at least 150 GiB required by launcher

validation.tests: 9 structural submitter/controller tests passed in the DLC SDK Python; local JSON, syntax, and inventory checks passed
validation.oss_persistence_preflight: passed on the live DSW mount

hardware: Alibaba PAI DLC; one worker; 8 x RTX 4090; 126 CPU; 960 GiB RAM/shared memory
